content: Isilie Bexinla Mutun Nigiedalai Bu Bei
Gaijiula, matanyi xienrenla eqighandei olien dourase haise daosan ene shiqinyi bi tai goude jilaghane giezho.
Manla olien dourase haise xili jienliezhi Musai daghawo.
Manla niekielienji ruhhertu ijiunii ijiewo.
Manla niekielienji ruhhertu usui ochiwo. Ochisanshi hhelare yosan ruhhertu tashise khizhesan wo. Ene tashishi Mexiha wo.
Ingieliuzhe hhelai dundadu fugie olie kunlade Huda xiqi wise hhelai hontande alawo.
Fashen giesan ene shiqinla matande jingao giezhi hhela mutun doghun shiqinni bu neii giezho.
Ye hhelai dundadu kunla mutun nigiedalai bu beii giezho. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Bexinla sousenu ochizhi ijiene, bosizhese nadune."
Hhela kunlare lon kijiezhi niudude 23000 kun fuguwo. Matan hhela mutun bu gieye.
Hhelai dundadu kunla Ezhanni shiidene moghei zhou alawo. Matan hhela mutun Ezhanni bu shiiye.
Hhela boxin kieliedene azaraili qienxien hhelai aminni agiwo. Ta hhela mutun boxin bu kielie.
Enezighan shiqinla hhelai jiere fashen giezhi kunlade jingao giezho. Matan enezighan duya baraku kunlade surughane giezhi huaizho.
Ingiese goyane beizhi undanlawo giesanla indan xioxin gie, pse banjine.
Tande iresan shiiku kunlade man wine. Hudashi kekaoni wo, Hhe tande danji daku shiikui ulie ireghane. Shiikude tande nie piiku mo keighazhi tai danji shidaghane.
Nigiedalai Beiikuse Gholodo
Ingiese mii orentula, ta nigiedalai beiikuse gholodo.
Bi minbaitu kunlade kieliezho, bi kieliesanlai ta goyalane uzhezhi gie.
Matan onxian giedene ochisan fuqitu beizishi Mexihani chusunde hhantulasan pushonu? Matan ginan ghuluzhi ijiekude Mexihani beyede hhantulasan pushonu?
Ginan niekozi wo, matan kun olon woma, nie beye wo. Matan man nie ginande hhantulazho.
Ta Isilie bexinlai sumula, sidagha gieku teizi jieredu dunxii ijiesanlashi sidagha gieku teizide hhantulasan pushonu?
Bi kieliesanshi yan isi wo? Nigieda, pse nigiedade ogisan ijiunishi yan wo? Yamada pusho!
Bi kieliesanshi niman kunla ogise Hudade ese ogizho, sheitande ogizho. Bi tai sheitanre hhantulaghaku duran uwo.
Ta Ezhanni beizii ochidene sheitanni beizii ochise jiedui ulie olune. Ezhanni xii soudene sheitanni xii souse jiedui ulie olune.
Matan Ezhanni reizhi hokughanu? Matan hhense fama onu?
Yan gieliuzhe Hudai Kuaine Giezhi Gie
Yanniliuzhe giese olune giezhi kunla kieliezhoma, man haochu wineku pusho. Yanniliuzhe giese olune giezhoma, man kunlai hendaghakui pusho.
Kienliuzhe goyane haochude bu olu, kunlai haochude olu.
Shichande huisan mighalai ta man ijie, lianxinni yenyinghala yama bu asadene ijie.
Zemin, zemin jiere durusanlashi man Ezhannughun wo.
Niezhan xianxin ulie giesan kunla tai xinlazhi ijieghase ta duran bizhi echise tai melie beilasanlai ijie, lianxinni yenyinghala yama bu asa.
Bifan "eneshi nigiedade xienji giesan ijiuni wo" giezhi kunla tande kieliese, hhe kunde oluzhi, lianxinni yenyinghala bu ijie.
Bi kieliesanshi tai lianxin pusho, hhe kunyi lianxin wo. Mii ziyuni yangiezhi kunlai lianxinghala kieliene?
Bi mafan kieliedene ijiese yangiezhi bi mafan kieliesan ijiunii yenyinghala mii sugiene?
Ingiese ta ijie, ochi yan gieliuzhe Hudai kuaine giezhi gie.
Bugon Yutai kun, Xila kun, Hudai jiohuiliuzhe ta hhelai bu banjigha.
Bi giesan mutun yan shiqindeliuzhe kunlai bayasugha. Goyane haochude bu oludene kunlai haochude oluzhi hhelai jiuigha.
